snippet.title: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia | Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter fractured memories where every shift in perception changes the path ahead.

Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia is a puzzle action-adventure game set in a solarpunk dystopian world.

Play as Ai'Lynn, a scientist capable of entering and manipulating memories, and uncover the truth hidden within her own mind.

Switch between two perception states to reveal hidden paths, overcome shifting obstacles, and solve puzzles across memories shaped by the past.

Wishlist Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia on Steam
